subject: For additional compatibility this adds REDIS_CFLAGS and REDIS_LDFLAGS support to MAKEFILE (#66)
reason: The change is build-system only: src/Makefile gets comment wording updates and new optional REDIS_CFLAGS/REDIS_LDFLAGS variables that merely alias SERVER_CFLAGS/SERVER_LDFLAGS at compile time. No runtime code path, command behavior, reply, or protocol is affected, so no fuzzer scenario can reach or test it.
